lines: In India, a family's health lives in WhatsApp chats, paper files, and late-night searches.
Meet Cheeku AI. One app, and one memory, for your whole family's health.
Arjun and Priya are ready for a baby. He asks Cheeku for her, and the answer comes from her own reports.
Her thyroid test is booked for home collection, and the report files itself, every value tracked over time.
Then, it's positive. Now everything is read against week twelve.
Booking her gynaecologist takes a minute. The doctor gets her story before the call.
Every prescription is checked at salt level, on ten standards, against years of her history. Same salt, for less.
Then Tara arrives. One tap, and she has her own health file.
At midnight, she runs a fever. Cheeku knows she's seven weeks old, and gets a paediatrician on video, tonight.
After the call, the prescription is filed, doses are set, and the follow-up waits in her memory.
A GP for Arjun. Therapy, physio, nurses at home, medicines delivered. Insurance, coming soon.
Even a gym class, picked for his blood sugar.
Every report, booking and dose feeds Cheeku's longevity engine. Each morning, everyone gets small steps, made for their own numbers.
Built for a hundred crore Indians.
Cheeku AI. Your family's health, remembered.
